title: Combine masked multi-task losses
prompt: Combine per-example task loss vectors using Boolean availability masks. Return weighted sum of each observed task mean and observed counts. An all-missing task contributes differentiable zero. Missing losses may be NaN: select before reducing, not NaN*zero. Task-loader scheduling is outside this objective core.
